race.description: Real Punters Play Here Tabtouch Hcp (C1)
race.comment: LUKA MAGIC (2) won two back before a 2.3L defeat over this trip at Belmont last time out. He rates highly on the back of that effort and maps to get every chance here. Noske remains on board and if he runs to recent efforts, he can get back to winning ways. MISS VEUVE (5) finished off well at Pinjarra last time out and looks ready for this trip now. She looks to be building towards another win and Brad Parnham now hops on board. Can be in the finish. STOLEN (8) was below her best last time, finishing tenth and beaten 8 lengths over 1800m at Pinjarra Scarpside. Won't be far away stepping back out in distance. HISTORY SUPREME (4) can improve with the blinkers on first time.
